candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so transferFrom no longer updates token ownership.
Set `_ownerOf[id] = from;` instead of `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so the token stays owned by the previous owner.
Remove the `WRONG_FROM` requirement so transferFrom can overwrite `_ownerOf[id]` for any id, including unminted ones.
Remove the zero-recipient check so transferring to address(0) succeeds and sets `_ownerOf[id]` to address(0) instead of reverting.
Remove `_ownerOf[id] = to;` from the overridden _mint so minted tokens are never recorded as owned.
Assign the token to `from` (address(0) at mint call sites) instead of `to`, so `_ownerOf[id]` is never the real recipient.
Remove the `ALREADY_MINTED` check so minting to an already-owned id overwrites `_ownerOf[id]` with the new owner instead of reverting.
